{{Quote|His name is Galiir Ac Yandar. He is a whining, sniveling, sycophant for which I have no use, but his organization is highly trained and would be an asset to the Empire.|Colonel Ekirk, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:II" />}}
'''Galiir Ac Yandar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was the leading member of the [[Nightstrike Soldier Hegemony]] (N.S.H.), a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] organization.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I want vengeance! Do you understand? They will ''not'' get away with this. Punish them. And if they die slowly and painfully, even better.|Galiir Ac Yandar, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:II" />}}
Galiir Ac Yandar was the leader of the Nightstrike Soldier Hegemony, a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] organization that operated on the planet Talus.<ref name="SWG:II" /> During the Galactic Civil War between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], the N.S.H. was affiliated with the Galactic Empire and directly involved in the fight against the Rebellion.<ref name="SWG:RI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Rebel Investigation|Talus}}</ref>

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Galiir Ac Yandar sought to make his unit a full military branch of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial armed forces]] rather than a separate entity.<ref name="SWG:II" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Ac Yandar met Imperial [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Braedic Ekirk]] in [[Imperial Office|his office]] in [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]] to negotiate the new operational status of the Nightstrike Soldier Hegemony. Ekirk deeply despised Galiir but considered that the N.S.H. could be a valuable asset for the Empire. However, the negotiations were disturbed when [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] of the [[Aggregate Civil Liberties Organization]] (A.C.L.O.), an anti-Imperial movement, planted information in Ac Yandar's computer that almost ruined his reputation with the Empire. Colonel Ekirk thus dispatched a spacer to raid the [[A.C.L.O. office]].<ref name="SWG:II" /> The spacer was recommended by [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] officer [[Dathnaeya Loessin]], who wanted to determine what kind of people the Rebellion and the Empire had chosen to work with.<ref name="SWG:CoA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Crisis of Allegiance|Talus}}</ref> Colonel Ekirk tasked the spacer with slaying A.C.L.O. terrorists who sabotaged Imperial shipments. In addition, Galiir Ac Yandar ordered the spacer to kill [[Leeta Poandeu]], the slicer who had sliced his system.<ref name="SWG:II" /> Furthermore, Galiir Ac Yandar requested the spacer assist [[Mark Hieks]], an N.S.H. [[Spy/Legends|covert operative]] in the A.C.L.O. office, in placing monitoring devices on the A.C.L.O.'s computers.<ref name="SWG:MHDCA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Mark Hieks, Deep Cover Agent" on Talus</ref> The spacer eventually achieved all those objectives and was rewarded by Galiir Ac Yandar for the assistance.<ref name="SWG:RttI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Report to the Imperials|Talus}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Galiir Ac Yandar appeared as a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:II" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Galiir Ac Yandar was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Crisis of Allegiance|Crisis of Allegiance]]" arc with the release of "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 2|Chapter 2: The Talus Incident]]," on [[August 1]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 2: The Talus Incident Publish Notes, August 1st">{{SonyForumsCite|full_url=http://soe.lithium.com/swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=58871|text="Chapter 2: The Talus Incident" Publish Notes, August 1st}}</ref>
